entities.name: Bratislava as Hungarian Capital
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: After the Ottoman capture of Buda (1541), Bratislava became the capital of Royal Hungary. Eleven Hungarian kings were crowned in St. Martin's Cathedral. The city became a centre of Renaissance and later Counter-Reformation culture.
